params.name: ignoreDismissedAt
params.description:
Sometimes you may want to view notices that have already been dismissed. Set this parameter to `true` to view
all notices regardless of when they've been dismissed.

params.name: rangeInDays
params.description:
Limit the range of the notices that will be returned. By default, the endpoint will pull in everything since
the last time the user dismissed notices. This parameter can help restrict the window further.

items.docs:
